evidence_question: NRC EN 58200 identifies EOF normal/alternate power loss and failed alternate generator attempt
minimum_artifacts: Event Notification 58200 text/citation; date/time; reportability basis

evidence_question: When was normal/alternate EOF power restored and when was the EOF declared available?
minimum_artifacts: restoral log; facility availability status; timestamp; authority basis

evidence_question: What caused the alternate/backup generator failure and power unavailability?
minimum_artifacts: root-cause/CAP record; failure mode; owner; date; disposition

evidence_question: What repair or configuration correction was completed?
minimum_artifacts: work order; corrective maintenance record; parts/configuration; signoff

evidence_question: Was the alternate/backup generator load/functional-tested against acceptance criteria?
minimum_artifacts: post-maintenance test; load/functional criteria; pass/fail; retest if failed

evidence_question: What compensatory measures preserved emergency assessment/communications functions while the EOF was degraded?
minimum_artifacts: compensatory procedure/checklist; activation time; staffing; communications/product logs

evidence_question: Was EOF power/recovery/alternate facility state in the June 2026 exercise scope or excluded?
minimum_artifacts: extent-of-play; objective matrix; evaluator notes; meeting answer; explicit exclusion if excluded

evidence_question: Was a 10 CFR 50.73 LER required/submitted or explicitly determined not required?
minimum_artifacts: LER/no-LER determination; ADAMS accession; regulatory basis; date

evidence_question: Did NRC inspection or licensee CAP identify recurrence prevention or unresolved issues?
minimum_artifacts: inspection report; CAP closure; recurrence-control measure; unresolved state

evidence_question: If all prior artifacts arrive, classify them as candidate evidence without global readiness closure.
minimum_artifacts: intake ledger; proofcut status; reviewer note; unresolved limitations
